controls.limitation: Compile-time checks only; vector field/index applicability and runtime units are not tested. QR REPORT/REGISTER CLIENT are observations of historical full-compiler constraints, not required negative controls: checkSyntax does not establish their empty-call validity.

documentationExamples.standard: 0 errors and 0 warnings, the same bar GATE G4 holds the synthetic corpus to
documentationExamples._bucket2Note: Mechanical wrapping is implemented (declare locals the fragment uses but does not declare; host a class-body fragment in a class file) and was applicable to 55 of the failing snippets, but rescued none of them. The failures are semantic, not syntactic: the dominant causes are an unknown project table or ORDA dataclass (cs.EmployeeSelection, cs.EmployeeEntity, [Employee], [Person] and friends), a user class whose members the page never shows, a literal `...` elision, published content that is not 4D at all despite the `4d` code fence (Collection.orderBy's JSON shape, Collection.indices' query grammar), and a handful of genuine typos in the docs. Making these compile would require inventing a data model or a class API, which is exactly what bucket 3 exists to refuse -- so they are kept byte-for-byte as published.

hoverDiscrepancies.reason: Hover still shows the `{ ; * }` that FolderClass.html documents, because hover renders the doc string. The parser disagrees with the doc: tool4d accepts `Folder("/PACKAGE"; fk posix path; *)` but rejects `4D.Folder.new("/PACKAGE"; fk posix path; *)` with a bare "Syntax error", and the sibling 4D.File.new documents no `*` at all. The IR follows the parser via pipeline/oop/semantic_overlays/4D.Folder.new.json, so this arity difference is expected and is not an IR bug.

R5 hover repeats the documented 4D.QuotaManager spelling. The matched 21R5.100156 compiler rejects that type and accepts 4D.QuotaManagerClass for the same Session.quotas assignment. See positive/negative controls in out/oop_type_name_crosscheck.json and the Session.quotas overlay.

R5 hover repeats the documented 4D.QuotaManager spelling. The matched 21R5.100156 compiler rejects that type and accepts 4D.QuotaManagerClass; G4 verifies the WEB Server.quotas assignment with the corrected type. See out/oop_type_name_crosscheck.json and the WebServer.quotas overlay.

verificationScope: Source-bound tool4d experimental/checkSyntax static compile checks and separate hover checks; not runtime execution or proof of every full-application arity rule.

limitations.detail: The documented historical full-compiler empty-call restrictions are retained conservatively. Fresh 21R5.100156 checkSyntax probes report no diagnostics for both bare and parenthesized empty calls; they are not passed arity negatives, do not promote the calls to valid, and do not erase the historical evidence. The fabricated-command rejection control does fail with Syntax error.

Keep authored variable-based scalar arguments rather than literal substitutions. The current bridge checkSyntax gate is not evidence of full-application compiler/runtime addressability and this historical restriction is not presented as freshly reproduced.
Both real paired SQL blocks compile cleanly; neither structural delimiter has a hover entry. The two gaps are accounted for separately, not signature agreement.
All 122 View Pro commands remain in the IR but have no synthetic methods/compiler verdicts. Do not claim compiler verification for this intentional exclusion.

oopGateLimitations.tcpPort: checkSyntax accepts Integer, Real, Text and Collection port expressions. Retain the documented Integer domain; acceptance cannot prove valid runtime ports.
